statement.zh: 阿布萨拉比赫西丘地表清理记录了建筑与器物（组合级），见 Postgate《阿布萨拉比赫发掘》第 1 卷（1983）。
statement.en: At Abu Salabikh, West Mound surface clearance recorded architecture and finds (assemblage-level), as documented in Postgate ASE vol. 1 (1983).
